facts: FRA 8431 arrived in the harbor between last boats well after protest time limit expire.
During mooring the boat FRA 8431 got a rope trapped between the rudder and keel and need to sort it.
After FRA 8431 moored the boat, she immediately checked Official Notice Board and saw a protest against her was lodged.
She immediately went to the Jury Room and arrived just after the decision was given.
conclusions: FRA 8431 was unavoidably absent from the hearing. Therefore, the requirements in RRS 63.7(a)(1) for reopening the hearing are met.
